title: Reachability by a bounded walk
statement: Let $E$ be a relation on the natural numbers, let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $c,t<n$. There is a finite path from $c$ to $t$ using steps of $E$ whose endpoints are both less than $n$ if and only if there is a walk from $c$ to $t$ of length at most $n$, with every intermediate vertex less than $n$. A walk of length zero is allowed.
